name: ASGI config for conversationalBI project.  It exposes the ASGI callable as a mod
summary: Django ASGI configuration exposing the asynchronous application entry point.
purpose: Provides the ASGI-compatible callable required by asynchronous web servers to serve the Django application, enabling support for concurrent connections, asynchronous views, and real-time protocols.
responsibilities: Initialize the Django ASGI application via the framework factory
Expose the module-level 'application' callable for ASGI servers
Enable asynchronous request processing and protocol support
inputs: ASGI connection scope and events from the web server
architecture_notes: Standard Django ASGI entry point following the ASGI specification. It serves as the boundary layer between an ASGI-compatible server (e.g., Uvicorn, Daphne) and the Django framework, delegating initialization to django.core.asgi.get_asgi_application(). This design decouples server configuration from application logic and is essential for deployments leveraging async capabilities, WebSockets, or HTTP/2.
improvements: Integrate Django Channels routing if the project requires WebSocket support for real-time conversational features

Consider environment-specific ASGI middleware for observability, security, or rate limiting
